dedupe_keys.name: chdsr daily diffuse solar radiation for china

description: The CHDSR research team publishes daily diffuse surface solar-radiation estimates for China on a ten-kilometre grid. The product combines the REST2 clear-sky model with reanalysis inputs and machine-learning methods. Figshare lists annual archives and NetCDF examples, publicly available and free under CC BY 4.0. Its title claims coverage from 1980 to 2022, but the inspected annual-file manifest begins in 1982 and ends in 2022. This difference is retained, not assuming the earlier years are present. The estimates can support solar-resource simulations and comparisons with model-system-advisor-model-sam and data-era5-reanalysis. A caveat is that diffuse radiation is a modelled quantity, not a dense national station observation network. The complete generation code is not publicly released because of REST2 licensing. No raster files were downloaded.
